d: Anant sinh shaukin hain... pahanne ke bhi.. gariyon ke bhi aur nach gane ke bhi. beti ki shadi ke lie mokama men jis tarah ka mahaul unhonne sajaya tha uski charcha akele bihar men hi nahin balki pure desh men ho rahi hai. shadi se pahle beti ke tilak samaroh men anant sinh ek hajar gariyon ke kaphile ke sath nikle the.. samaroh men kendriy mantri giriraj sinh aur mantri vijay sinha sahit darjanon neta shamil hue the. daraasal anant sinh parti ya kshetr ke bandhan men bandhkar rahne vale neta nahin hain... isi mahine 6 navanbar ko saikron gariyon ke kaphile ke sath unhonne patna se…
